# Venue memo

Search date: 21 July 2026.

## Target: Journal of Statistical Physics

Best fit because the central result is a rigorous statement about a finite Gibbs specification, conditional concentration, product-domination quantifiers, and Dobrushin coefficients. The journal's stated scope includes original work across statistical physics and related collective phenomena. The 21-page manuscript plus technical appendices is proportionate for a regular article.

Journal page: <https://link.springer.com/journal/10955>

## First fallback: Journal of Mathematical Physics

Appropriate for the compact-group geometry, heat-kernel LDP, and lattice gauge application. It is a better fallback if editors view the Dobrushin component as secondary to mathematical gauge theory.

Journal page: <https://pubs.aip.org/aip/jmp>

## Second fallback: Letters in Mathematical Physics

Appropriate if the manuscript is compressed around the obstruction theorem and compact-group extension. Its stated scope covers original developments in mathematical and theoretical physics and allows both letters and longer research articles.

Journal page: <https://link.springer.com/journal/11005>

## Positioning decision

Submit first as a regular mathematical-statistical-physics article, not as a Yang–Mills mass-gap paper. Do not lead with the broader research program. A Communications in Mathematical Physics submission would be reasonable only after an external expert confirms the priority boundary and recommends the stronger venue.

Formatting is currently generic LaTeX. Venue-specific class conversion should occur only after the author identity and target are confirmed.
